theme: Three days of letting it take time — practicing patience in an impatient world

days.task: Notice every moment today where impatience arises. Write them down. What are you impatient about — and why?
When you feel urgency today, deliberately add a pause before acting. Note each one. What changed when you waited?
Do something today knowing the result is weeks or months away. Do it anyway. Write about what it means to work for the future.
